title: Birth near Nashville and the nickname Doc
summary: Cheatham was born in 1905 outside Nashville and got the name Doc from the medical-college neighbourhood; he played cornet in a little symphony, later soprano sax.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Born in Nashville, Tennessee. June 13, 1905. In fact it was outside of Nashville, in a little town between Nashville and Murfreesboro, but now it's called all the city of Nashville.
Now is that -- is it true that you got your nickname Doc, because there were a lot of doctors in the family.

Yes, yes. We lived in Nashville just in the (unintelligible) Mehari medical college vicinity. Just about right in that area. And when I started playing, I was playing trumpet in the Mehari Little Symphony Orchestra, which we played a little concert every first Sunday. And before the -- I guess the president of G. W. Hubbard then was the president of Mehari. And the Hubbard Hospital was named after him there. He always delivered a sermon something like that every first Sunday of the month. Some of the students, we played instruments we all had a little symphony. Played a selection before that. And neighbors -- people called me Doc like they did everybody else there.
Uh-huh, well what were you playing?
Because later you also took up soprano sax?
